edits.proposed: The universal Colombian rule - payment or credit in account. Applies to the electronic payroll (DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2), to Form 350, to Form 220 and to Format 2276.

edits.current: The rolling six-month average that drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper - full exemption where it does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026). The resolution restricts it expressly: 'UNICAMENTE para employees que aplique el numeral 4 art. 206 E.T.'. The engine must maintain the average YEAR-ROUND; it cannot be reconstructed from annual totals.
edits.proposed: The rolling six-month average that drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper - full exemption where it does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026). The resolution restricts it expressly: 'UNICAMENTE para employees que aplique el numeral 4 art. 206 E.T.'. The engine must maintain the average YEAR-ROUND; it cannot be reconstructed from annual totals. HOW THE AVERAGE IS TAKEN: the monthly average SALARY ('salario mensual promedio', ET art. 206 num. 4) of six months - on termination or on a withdrawal of severance, the last six months of employment or the six months before the withdrawal; while the employment continues, the six months of the immediately preceding year at the time of the deposit to the fund; for employees outside the Ley 50 de 1990 regime, the six months before the employer recognises the severance (ET art. 27 num. 3) (DIAN Concepto 4443 de 2025).

edits.current: Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the attribute 'voluntary pension fund (art. 126-1)'. The art. 55 / art. 126-1 attribute of each voluntary-pension deduction wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC), across the '(FVOL)' provider wage types (25811-25815, 25823) and the institutional-plan wage types (25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 65803, 65804). Employee contributions deducted through payroll are reported here; employer contributions to institutional plans are distinguished from them through the employer- / employee-side attribute of each institutional-plan wage type (including the payment / bonus entries 65803 and 65804), which also comes from the WTC. Maps to Form 220 casilla 56.
edits.proposed: Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the attribute 'voluntary pension fund (art. 126-1)'. The art. 55 / art. 126-1 attribute of each voluntary-pension deduction wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC), across the '(FVOL)' provider wage types (25811-25815, 25823, and 21141 for retirees) and the institutional-plan wage types (25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 21212, 65803, 65804). Only the amount actually deducted from the employee's labour income in the employee's name is reported here, the rule of Form 220 casilla 56 (ET art. 126-1; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.1.22.41); employer contributions to institutional plans are distinguished from them through the employer- / employee-side attribute of each institutional-plan wage type (including the payment / bonus entries 65803 and 65804), which also comes from the WTC. Maps to Form 220 casilla 56.
